selection_rule: Three patients with the largest absolute GT-geometry to predicted-geometry EF error.
observed_pattern: The three largest segmentation-induced EF errors showed asymmetric ED/ES segmentation errors. ED cavity area was underestimated in all three cases, while ES area was either only slightly different or substantially overestimated. This reduced the estimated ED-to-ES volume change and resulted in substantial underestimation of EF.
image_quality_observation: The three cases included Good, Medium, and Poor image quality labels. Therefore, large downstream errors were not confined to a single image-quality category.
interpretation_limit: These cases were selected because they had the largest errors and are used for qualitative failure analysis. They should not be interpreted as representative of all test patients.
